user_question: Calculate mean elevation for every census tract that intersects State College borough.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate mean elevation for every census tract that intersects State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve census tract polygons
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a GeoPackage census tract dataset covering State College borough for downstream spatial selection.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked available census tract polygon dataset covering State College borough. Return a GeoPackage candidate; do not assume suitability until runtime metadata inspection.

workflow_steps.title: Select census tracts intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Spatially join census tract polygons with the State College borough boundary while retaining the tract geometries for zonal statistics.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform an intersects-based spatial join between the census tract candidate and the State College borough boundary. Retain one record and the original geometry for every census tract that intersects the borough. Do not guess or hard-code field names; runtime QC must ground any required identifier fields from observed schemas.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by intersecting census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute mean DEM elevation for each census tract selected by intersection with State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute mean elevation from the 30 m GeoTIFF DEM for each polygon in selected_census_tracts. Preserve a census tract identifier in the CSV output. Use the selected tract geometries rather than only the borough intersection fragments. Do not guess field names; runtime QC must ground the tract identifier and any zone/value fields from observed schemas.

requirements.scope: The retrieved census tract candidate must cover the State College borough boundary and contain the census tracts needed for the requested intersection.
The retrieved census tract candidate must be available as a GeoPackage for the spatial join worker.
The census tract candidate and State College borough boundary must have compatible CRSs for the spatial join.
The census tract candidate must contain valid, non-empty polygon geometries suitable for spatial joining.
The selected tract output must retain a field that uniquely identifies each census tract.
The DEM and selected census tract polygons must have compatible CRSs for zonal statistics.
The selected census tract polygons must be valid and non-empty for zonal statistics.
The DEM must cover the full geometry of every selected census tract so each reported tract mean represents the requested tract.
The selected tract layer must contain a unique census tract identifier that is propagated to the mean-elevation CSV.

agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic raster reprojection, resampling, clipping, raster calculation, and zonal statistics. Consumes GeoTIFF rasters and GeoPackage polygon zones.
